stories.headline: Samsung Q1 Chip Profit Jumps 49x to Record $36B as Memory Shortage Set to Worsen in 2027

key_facts.fact: Samsung Q1 operating profit reached a record ₩57.2 trillion ($40.1B), with the chip division accounting for ₩53.7 trillion ($36.15B) — a 49-fold year-over-year increase from ₩1.1 trillion.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung said January-March operating profit in its cash cow chip division reached a record 53.7 trillion won ($36.15 billion) from just 1.1 trillion won in the same period a year earlier. That made up 94% of the quarter's 57.2 trillion won record total.

key_facts.fact: Revenue rose 69% YoY to ₩133.9 trillion ($93.7B), an all-time quarterly high, beating the analyst estimate of ~₩130 trillion.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics said Thursday it posted first-quarter revenue of 133.87 trillion won ($93.7 billion) and operating profit of 57.23 trillion won ($40.1 billion). Revenue rose 69% from a year earlier.

key_facts.fact: Samsung warned the memory supply-demand gap will widen further in 2027: 'Based solely on the demand currently received for 2027, the supply-to-demand gap for 2027 is set to widen even further than in 2026.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'Our supply falls far short of customer demand,' said Samsung's Kim Jaejune. 'Based solely on the demand currently received for 2027, the supply-to-demand gap for 2027 is set to widen even further than in 2026.'

key_facts.fact: Samsung started the industry's first mass-production sales of HBM4 chips and SOCAMM2 modules for Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform, and will deliver HBM4E samples in Q2 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics added that in the second quarter it will begin shipping customer samples of HBM4E, a next-generation product for next year, rushing to be the first in the industry to supply it following HBM4.

key_facts.fact: HBM revenue is forecast to more than triple this year versus last year, with HBM4's share of total HBM revenue expected to exceed 50% starting in Q3 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: 'Our HBM revenue this year is forecast to surge more than three-fold from last year,' said Park Soon-cheol, Samsung Electronics' CFO. 'Customer demand is concentrated on HBM4 for its differentiated performance, and sales volume is already fully sold out.'

key_facts.fact: Samsung has signed multi-year binding contracts with customers hoping to lock in supplies, and said it expects to increase capital expenditure sharply this year to meet AI demand.
key_facts.excerpt: The world's top memory chipmaker by sales also said it has signed multi-year binding contracts with customers hoping to lock in supplies, without disclosing identities or terms.

key_facts.fact: DRAM ASPs rose roughly 90-95% sequentially from Q4 to Q1, signaling sharp tightening in memory markets tied to AI-driven demand.
key_facts.excerpt: The Memory Business set an all-time high for quarterly revenue and operating profits due to its technological leadership in the memory market and higher average selling price (ASP).

stories.headline: Nvidia B300 Server Prices Nearly Double to ~$1M in China as Smuggling Crackdown Dries Up Supply

key_facts.fact: Nvidia B300 server prices in China have nearly doubled to about 7 million yuan (~$1 million) each, up from about 4 million yuan late last year, nearly double the ~$550,000 US price.
key_facts.excerpt: Strong demand for AI computing equipment in China has nearly doubled prices for Nvidia's B300 servers to about 7 million yuan ($1 million) each... A B300 server is priced at about $550,000 in the United States.

key_facts.fact: The scarcity followed U.S. authorities' March prosecution of Yih-Shyan 'Wally' Liaw, a co-founder of Nvidia partner Supermicro, which disrupted the grey market supply channel.
key_facts.excerpt: The scarcity followed U.S. authorities' March prosecution of Yih-Shyan 'Wally' Liaw, a co-founder of Nvidia partner Supermicro, the sources added.

key_facts.fact: Chinese tech companies avoid holding Nvidia hardware directly on their books for fear of U.S. sanctions exposure; some are exploring rentals at up to 190,000 yuan/month.
key_facts.excerpt: Some companies finding the price rise has put purchases out of reach are instead exploring options for rentals, which have risen as high as 190,000 yuan a month on a one-year short-term contract.

key_facts.fact: The B300 server houses eight B300 GPUs with 288 GB of HBM, delivering 14 petaFLOPS at FP4 precision. Nvidia began shipping it last September.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia's B300, packed with 288 GB of high-bandwidth memory, delivers 14 petaFLOPS of computing power at FP4 precision... Nvidia and partners, such as Supermicro, began shipping the chip last September.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia still holds a 55% market share in China's AI chip market; Chinese AI models nearly tripled their share of global token usage to 32% in March 2026 from 5% a year earlier.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia's market-leading share of 55% in China... Chinese AI models nearly tripled their share of global token usage to 32% in March 2026 from 5% a year earlier.

key_facts.fact: Uncertainty around H200 chip exports has fueled the B300 price surge; despite receiving approvals from both governments, the H200 has yet to be shipped to China.
key_facts.excerpt: Despite receiving approvals from both governments for exports, the H200 has yet to be shipped to China as the two sides remain at odds over the conditions governing its sale.

stories.headline: Qualcomm Enters Custom ASIC Market, Will Ship Data Center Chips to a Hyperscaler by Q4 2026

key_facts.fact: CEO Cristiano Amon confirmed Qualcomm is working on three types of data center chips: CPUs, inference accelerators, and custom ASICs, and will begin shipping to a large hyperscaler before year-end.
key_facts.excerpt: Amon said the company is working with customers on three kinds of chips: central processing units (CPUs), accelerators for inference, and custom chips called ASICs... Qualcomm is working to break into the booming data center chip market, which it will start shipping products for before the end of the year.

key_facts.fact: Qualcomm's custom ASIC engagement was enabled by its $2.4 billion acquisition of AlphaWave Semi last year, providing connectivity IP for data center designs.
key_facts.excerpt: 'We have engagement on a custom ASIC, which is what we wanted to do when we bought AlphaWave,' Amon said, 'and now we have a lot of connectivity (intellectual property) that enables us to do that. We're executing on all three' categories of chips.

key_facts.fact: Q2 FY2026 revenue came in at $10.6 billion (down 3% YoY), with adjusted EPS of $2.65 beating the $2.56 consensus estimate. Shares surged ~15% in after-hours trading.
key_facts.excerpt: Qualcomm shares jumped 16 percent in after-hours trading after executives said the company plans to supply data centre chips to a large hyperscaler this year... adjusted earnings per share was $2.65, beating market expectations by $0.09. Revenue was $10.6 billion.

key_facts.fact: The data center push enters a market dominated by Broadcom (projected ~60% market share in custom ASICs) and Marvell. Qualcomm anticipates data center revenue beginning in fiscal 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: While Broadcom currently dominates the custom ASIC design space with a projected 60% market share, Qualcomm's entry could intensify competition in the sector.

key_facts.fact: Amon said Q3 would mark the bottom for Chinese handset revenue and that the smartphone market will rebound: 'We can now call the bottom.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'We can now call the bottom,' Amon said, adding that the company's licensing business, which beat estimates, gives it insights into smartphone makers' plans for later in the year.

stories.headline: OpenAI Hits 10GW Stargate Compute Target Years Ahead of 2029 Goal, Adding 3GW in 90 Days

key_facts.fact: OpenAI has surpassed its goal of 10GW of AI computing capacity in the U.S., originally set for 2029, adding over 3GW in the past 90 days alone.
key_facts.excerpt: When we announced Stargate in January 2025, we committed to securing 10GW of AI infrastructure in the United States by 2029. Just over a year later, we have already surpassed that milestone, with more than 3GW added in the last 90 days alone.

key_facts.fact: GPT-5.5, OpenAI's newest flagship model, was trained at the Stargate site in Abilene, Texas, which runs on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and is equipped with Nvidia GB200 systems.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI revealed that its newest flagship model, GPT-5.5, was trained at the Stargate site in Abilene, Texas, which runs on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and is equipped with Nvidia GB200 systems.

key_facts.fact: Stargate is a $500 billion AI infrastructure project launched in January 2025 with partners Oracle, SoftBank, Nvidia, and Microsoft.
key_facts.excerpt: Stargate was unveiled in January 2025 as a $500 billion venture among OpenAI, Oracle Corp. and SoftBank Group Corp.

key_facts.fact: The announcement came one day after reports that OpenAI missed internal revenue and user growth targets, which triggered a sell-off in AI-linked stocks including SoftBank (-12%).
key_facts.excerpt: The disclosure came one day after a report that OpenAI's core metrics had missed internal expectations triggered a sharp sell-off in AI-linked stocks, with SoftBank Group's ADR plunging 12.11%.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI's compute partnerships include Oracle ($300B five-year supply contract), AMD (6GW GPU capacity deal with up to 160M warrants), and Broadcom (10GW custom AI accelerators starting H2 2026).
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle had previously signed a five-year, $300 billion compute supply contract with OpenAI. AMD signed a multi-year deal with OpenAI to deploy 6 GW of GPU capacity... Broadcom is collaborating with OpenAI to develop 10 GW worth of custom AI accelerators.

stories.headline: SoftBank Plans Roze AI Robotics and Data Center Company, Eyes $100B U.S. IPO as Early as 2026

key_facts.fact: SoftBank is creating a new company called Roze AI that will focus on building data centers in the U.S. and using autonomous robots to improve construction efficiency.
key_facts.excerpt: SoftBank is putting together a new business called Roze AI... Roze would seek to make data center construction in the U.S. more 'efficient'... by deploying autonomous robots to help build server farms.

key_facts.fact: SoftBank is targeting a valuation of about $100 billion and aiming to list Roze as early as the second half of 2026, driven by founder Masayoshi Son.
key_facts.excerpt: SoftBank founder and Chief Executive Masayoshi Son is driving the effort, with executives reportedly targeting a valuation of about $100 billion and aiming to pursue the initial public offering this year.

key_facts.fact: Roze could bundle existing SoftBank portfolio assets including energy, land, infrastructure, and ABB Robotics, which SoftBank agreed to buy last year.
key_facts.excerpt: Roze could also reportedly bundle existing energy, land and infrastructure assets from SoftBank's portfolio, as well as ABB Robotics, which SoftBank agreed to buy last year.

key_facts.fact: The IPO would help offset SoftBank's massive AI commitments, including more than $30 billion pledged to OpenAI and its role in the $500 billion Stargate project.
key_facts.excerpt: The proposed listing could help offset some of the major pledges, including more than $30 billion committed to OpenAI.

key_facts.fact: Some SoftBank executives have expressed skepticism about the valuation target and proposed IPO timeline, partly due to uncertainties from the Middle East conflict.
key_facts.excerpt: The FT notes that some inside SoftBank have expressed skepticism 'about the valuation and the proposed timeline for an IPO.'

stories.headline: Big Tech Q1 Capex Hits Record $130B; Combined 2026 Spending Could Top $650B on AI Buildout

key_facts.fact: Meta raised its 2026 capex guidance to $125-145 billion (from $115-135B), citing higher memory prices and AI infrastructure expansion. Shares fell ~6% in after-hours.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta raised its full-year capital expenditure guidance to $125 billion to $145 billion and then slid about 6 percent in after-hours trading.

key_facts.fact: Alphabet raised 2026 capex guidance to $180-190 billion (from $175-185B) and said 2027 capex would 'significantly increase.' Google Cloud revenue grew 63% YoY to $20B.
key_facts.excerpt: Alphabet said 2027 capex would be 'significantly' higher... Google Cloud revenue +63% year-over-year.

key_facts.fact: Amazon's Q1 capital spending was $43.2 billion, primarily tied to AWS and generative AI. Free cash flow collapsed 95% to $1.2 billion as operating cash flow was consumed by infrastructure investment.
key_facts.excerpt: CFO Brian Olsavsky said Amazon's capital spending was $43.2 billion in the first quarter, primarily tied to AWS and generative AI... free cash flow fell 95% to $1.2 billion over the past 12 months.

key_facts.fact: Microsoft's AI business surpassed a $37 billion annual revenue run rate, up 123% YoY. Azure revenue grew 40% YoY. Microsoft 365 Copilot has 20M+ seats.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft posted fiscal third-quarter revenue of $82.89 billion and operating profit of $38.4 billion. Annualised revenue from its AI business expanded to $37.0 billion, with year-on-year growth reaching 123 percent.

key_facts.fact: Industry analysis projects combined 2026 capex by Amazon, Google, Meta and Microsoft could exceed $650-725 billion, up 77% from ~$410 billion in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: The industry is even raising the possibility that combined capital expenditure (CAPEX) by Amazon, Google, Meta and Microsoft in 2026 could exceed $650 billion.

key_facts.fact: Meta's CFO said the company has 'continued to underestimate compute needs,' and Mark Zuckerberg said Meta is rolling out over 1 GW of custom AI silicon developed with Broadcom, plus adding significant AMD capacity alongside new Nvidia systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta raised 2026 capex from $115-$135 billion to $125-145 billion, while noting that a large part of the increase was due to higher memory prices.

stories.headline: Amazon Custom Chips Business Tops $20B Run Rate With Triple-Digit Growth as AWS Backlog Hits $364B

key_facts.fact: Amazon's custom chips business topped a $20 billion annual revenue run rate, growing at triple-digit rates year-over-year, encompassing Trainium and Graviton processors.
key_facts.excerpt: AWS is growing 28% on a very large base, our chips business topped a $20 billion revenue run rate (growing triple digits year-over-year).

key_facts.fact: AWS revenue grew 28% YoY to $37.6 billion in Q1, its fastest growth in 15 quarters, while Amazon's overall Q1 revenue rose 17% to $181.5 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue from AWS rose 28% to $37.6 billion, ahead of Wall Street expectations.

key_facts.fact: AWS backlog reached $364 billion for the quarter, not including the recently announced Anthropic deal worth more than $100 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Jassy said AWS's backlog — business Amazon has already contracted but not yet recognized as revenue — was $364 billion for the quarter. That figure does not include Amazon's recently announced Anthropic deal for more than $100 billion.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI committed to consume about 2 GW of Trainium capacity through AWS beginning in 2027, while Anthropic secured up to 5 GW of current and future Trainium chips.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon also said OpenAI committed to consume about 2 gigawatts of Trainium capacity through AWS beginning in 2027, while Anthropic secured up to 5 gigawatts of current and future generations of Amazon's Trainium chips.

key_facts.fact: CEO Andy Jassy said memory and storage costs have 'skyrocketed,' with memory under the most pressure, reinforcing why hyperscalers are investing in custom silicon.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon's first-quarter net sales rose 17 percent from a year earlier to $181.5 billion, and earnings per share topped the market estimate.
